About Slop Invoices

Slop Invoices makes invoices with numbers that never skip. An invoice gets its number when you issue it and is posted to the ledger, so an issued invoice cannot be edited. You can record payments, see what is overdue and what each customer owes, void an invoice while it is unpaid, and print or save it as a PDF. Everything stays in this browser, and nothing is uploaded.
